features.name: Teacher dashboard
features.description: Teachers can add and update students and marks in the system.

features.name: Student dashboard
features.description: Students can only view their own marks in the system.

constraints: The system must use a blue color theme.
No paid third-party APIs may be used.
acceptance_criteria: A teacher can add and update a student's information in the system.
A teacher can add and update a student's marks in the system.
A student can view their own marks in the system.
The system uses a blue color theme.
